user.title: VSSL MX
user.description: Enter the IP address of your VSSL amplifier (MX series: MA.1 / MS.1). The device must be on or in network standby and reachable from Home Assistant on port 80.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Check the IP and that it answers on port 80 (http://IP/index.fcgi).
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

init.title: VSSL MX options
init.description: Change the amplifier address or the name Home Assistant shows for it.

data_description.entity_name: Optional. Defaults to the device name plus the model, e.g. "Living room (MA1)". This decides the entity_id.
